name: Tomato rice (South Indian rice cooked with tomatoes)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 3. Pressure-cooker method: 1.5 cups raw basmati taken as 278 g long-grain white rice (raw) cooked in 2.5 cups (592 g) water, which is absorbed. 2 tbsp oil 27 g; 1 medium onion 110 g; 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste as 8 g ginger + 8 g garlic; 1 cup chopped tomatoes 180 g; 3/4 tsp salt 4.5 g; garam masala taken as curry powder (the recipe allows either) 1.5 g; 3/4 tsp chili powder 2 g; 12 cashews 18 g (optional in recipe, included); whole spices: cumin 1.5 g, 1 inch cinnamon 1 g, 3 cardamoms 0.6 g, 3 cloves 0.3 g; bay leaf omitted. About 12% of the weight is lost as steam (sauteing and pressure release).

ingredients.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
